title: Dominic and the Crown
author: Orsen Nystrom
blurb: Xanthe Yarrow, a debt-bound temple scribe, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
